A full EPP scan on the compromised host detected a cryptocurrency miner but no ransomware binary, indicating potential evasion or incomplete detection.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        miterule = ["T1071.001"]
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET /" wide ascii
        $beacon_post = "POST /" wide ascii
        $header_host = "Host:" wide ascii
        $header_useragent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" wide ascii
        $xor_key = { 00 00 00 00 } // Common XOR patterns in staging
    condition:
        all of ($beacon_*) and $header_host and $header_useragent
}
